qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507.mistake: Multiple FOL statements fail to restrict the domain to mycologists when the natural language does. Specifically, in statements 9, 10, 12, and 14, the universal quantifier ∀x applies to all entities, but the NL statements refer only to mycologists. This leads to overgeneralization. For example, 'Any mycologist who investigates mold...' should be formalized as ∀x (is_mycologist(x) ∧ (p_14(x) ∨ p_3(x)) → p_13(x)) or similar, but the FOL lacks the mycologist condition. Since at least one mismatch exists, the overall correspondence is incorrect.
